existing_fixes_note: No Victorian destinations or spots exist in src/data yet; nothing to move.
notes: Kept places Lorne, Apollo Bay, Warrnambool and Portland are the destinations themselves (a destination is not a spot of itself); Port Campbell is a spot of Port Campbell National Park (town with its own harbour/beach draw).
Great Ocean Road and Great Ocean Walk are long linear features: not made destinations; Great South West Walk is placed at Portland, its access point.
Great Otway National Park is not proposed as a destination: its falls and walks are reached from Apollo Bay and Lorne and a park destination would overlap both.
Aireys Inlet is not a spot (rejected as wrapper for Split Point Lighthouse). Surf Coast name evidence is the weakest; check before applying.

Pins: coordinates are provisional. pin_status pin_needed = approximate hint only (memory), must be re-resolved by resolve-pin.py; National Wool Museum, Bay of Islands and Great South West Walk candidate coordinates were wrong (UK / Bellarine / SA border) and were replaced by hints.
Fort Queenscliff and Queenscliff share a town-centre point: pin-shared to resolve in the pins stage.
